The company was founded by [[Motilal Oswal]] and [[Raamdeo Agrawal]] in 1987.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/expert-view/motilal-oswal-franchise-is-wired-around-equity-raamdeo-agrawal/articleshow/71756502.cms|title=Don't take a crazy call when things are down: Raamdeo Agrawal|date=2019-10-25|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2020-02-19}}{{cite news|url=http://www.forbesindia.com/article/super-50-companies-2017/motilal-oswal-financial-services-the-house-that-raamdeo-agrawal-and-motilal-oswal-built/47661/1|title=Motilal Oswal Financial Services: The house that Raamdeo Agrawal and Motilal Oswal built|date=28 July 2018|work=Forbes India|publisher=forbesindia.com}} The company was listed on the stock exchange on September 11,2007, after its initial public offering (IPO).{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/motil-oswal-fin-28011/financials-profit-loss|title=Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd.|work=Business Standard India|access-date=2020-02-19}} ==History== Motilal Oswal Financial Services was set up by Motilal Oswal and Raamdeo Agrawal as a broking house in 1987.{{Cite web|url=http://www.forbesindia.com/article/super-50-companies-2017/motilal-oswal-financial-services-the-house-that-raamdeo-agrawal-and-motilal-oswal-built/47661/1|title=Motilal Oswal Financial Services: The House That Raamdeo Agrawal And Motilal Oswal Built|website=Forbes India|language=en|access-date=2020-02-19}} The company entered into [[investment banking]] in 2005, followed by private equity fund in 2006.{{Cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/Leisure/jYq9ULAx5636uVwDx7zKcJ/Motilal-Oswal--When-everyone-knows-your-name.html|title=Motilal Oswal {{!}} When everyone knows your name|last=Vadukut|first=Sidin|date=2008-11-01|website=Livemint|language=en|access-date=2020-02-19}} In February 2006, the company acquired Peninsular Capital Markets, a [[Cochin]], [[Kerala]] based broking company for Rs. 35 crore.{{Cite news|last=Gurav|first=Vijay|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/motilal-oswal-buys-peninsular-capital-for-rs-35-40-cr/articleshow/1408979.cms?from=mdr|title=Motilal Oswal buys Peninsular Capital for Rs 35-40 cr|date=2006-02-10|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2020-02-19}} The company tied up with [[State Bank of India]] in 2006,{{Cite web|url=https://www.oneindia.com/2006/11/23/sbi-ties-up-with-motilal-oswal-for-online-trading-1164337382.html|title=SBI ties-up with Motilal Oswal for online trading|last=Staff|date=2006-11-24|website=Oneindia|language=en|access-date=2020-02-19}} [[Punjab National Bank]] in 2007 and [[Axis Bank]] in 2013{{Cite news|last=Reporter|first=B. S.|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/finance/axis-bank-ties-up-with-motilal-oswal-for-online-trading-109052000170_1.html|title=Axis Bank ties up with Motilal Oswal for online trading|date=2009-05-20|work=Business Standard India|access-date=2020-02-19}} to offer online trading to its customers. In 2007, the company went public via IPO; the IPO was featured as a case study in [[Harvard Business School]].{{cite web |title=Motilal Oswal's IPO a case study for Harvard |url=https://mumbaimirror.indiatimes.com/news/business/motilal-oswals-ipo-a-case-study-for-harvard/articleshow/15700810.cms |access-date=January 18, 2023}} In January 2010, the company set up a [[mutual fund]] business named as Motilal Oswal Asset Management Company (MOAMC).{{Cite web|url=https://business.rediff.com/report/2010/jan/04/motilal-oswal-gets-sebi-bod-to-set-up-mf-biz.htm|title=Motilal Oswal gets Sebi bod to set up MF biz|website=Rediff|language=en|access-date=2020-02-19}} In 2013, the company established Aspire Home Finance Corporation Limited (AHFCL). The company offers loans for home, construction, composite, improvement and extension in [[India]].{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Motilal Oswal Home Finance Ltd - Company Profile and News|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/company/1186423D:IN|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-02-19|website=www.bloomberg.com}} In February 2024, Motilal Oswal Financial Services faced a cyberattack by the ransomware group [[LockBit]], which claimed to have accessed confidential data. This breach could affect the information of over six million clients and put at risk data related to the company's asset management and investment banking operations.{{cite news |last1=Tiwari |first1=Khushboo |title=Confidential data breach in Motilal Oswal by ransomware gang LockBit |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/confidential-data-breach-in-motilal-oswal-by-ransomware-gang-lockbit-124021800160_1.html |publisher=[[Business Standard]] |date=February 18, equity trading, commodity trading and investment advisory services, [[Initial public offering|IPOs]] and SIPs investment, portfolio management services, and mutual funds investment.{{cite web|url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/companies/MOFS.BO/|title=MOFS.BO - Stock Price & Latest News - Reuters|website=[[Reuters]] |accessdate=2023-01-14}} Motilal Oswal's client base was around 7.3 million at the end of June 2024.{{cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/motilal-oswal-stock-zooms-109-within-3-months-marketcap-tops-rs-62-000-cr-124101800589_1.html|title=Motilal Oswal stock zooms 109% within 3 months|website=[[Business Standard]]|accessdate=2024-10-18}} ==Controversies== Motilal Oswal along with a few other top brokers have been accused of various irregularities on the [[NSEL case]]. Agencies including the Economic Offence Wing-Mumbai and SFIO have found the top 5 brokers including Motilal Oswal guilty of [[misselling]] NSEL contracts, [[Know your customer|KYC]] manipulation, client code modification, illegal transactions & infusion of [[black money]] through their [[NBFC and MFI in India|NBFCs]] on the Exchange platform.{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/nsel-scam-2015-police-report-gives-sebi-fresh-ammo-against-brokers/article25926034.ece|title=NSEL scam: 2015 police report gives SEBI fresh ammo against brokers|first=PALAK|last=SHAH|website=@businessline|date=6 January 2019 }} The EOW had arrested senior employees of three brokers namely [[IIFL]], Geofin Comtrade & Anand Rathi in March, 2015.{{Cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/opoACHl01K4RiwZuuM4QKL/NSEL-case-Mumbai-Police-arrest-three-brokerage-officials.html|title=NSEL case: Mumbai Police arrests three top brokerage executives|first=Khushboo Narayan, Ashish|last=Rukhaiyar|date=3 March 2015|website=Livemint}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/eow-arrest-three-top-brokers-in-nsel-scam-115030301095_1.html|title=EOW arrest three top brokers in NSEL scam|first=B. S.|last=Reporter|newspaper=Business Standard India |date=4 March 2015|via=Business Standard}} This was followed by the market regulator, [[Securities and Exchange Board of India|SEBI]] issuing multiple show-cause notices to the brokers in 2016, 2017, 2018 and 2019 respectively.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/5-brokers-issued-supplementary-notices/articleshow/67376051.cms|title=5 brokers issued supplementary notices|first=Ram|last=Sahgal|newspaper=The Economic Times}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/finance/sebi-issues-another-show-cause-notice-to-nsel-brokers-in-2013-scam-probe-119010301169_1.html|title=Sebi issues another show-cause notice to NSEL brokers in 2013 scam probe|first=Dilip Kumar|last=Jha|date=3 January 2019|via=Business Standard}} The EOW-Mumbai in its supplementary charge sheet has also accused the three brokers IIFL, Motilal Oswal & Anand Rathi of cheating clients.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/non-defaulting-brokers-named-in-nsel-case/articleshow/67464884.cms|title=Non-defaulting brokers named in NSEL case|newspaper=The Economic Times}}{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/eow-submits-charge-sheet-against-63-in-nsel-scam/articleshow/67280876.cms|title=EOW submits charge sheet against 63 in NSEL scam|newspaper=The Economic Times}} Based on the recommendations of SFIO & EOW against misdeeds of these brokers, SEBI declared Motilal Oswal along with India Infoline Commodities (IIFL) ‘not fit and proper’ as [[commodity derivative]] brokers, in the last week of February 2019.{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/nsel-scam-sfio-wants-sebi-to-put-broker-firms-through-fit-and-proper-test/article25883571.ece|title=NSEL scam: SFIO wants SEBI to put broker-firms through 'fit and proper' test|website=@businessline|date=January 2019 }}{{Cite web|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/company-stock/nsel-scam-sebi-declares-motilal-oswal-iifl-not-fit-and-proper-commodity-derivatives/story/321560.html|title=NSEL Scam: SEBI declares Motilal Oswal, IIFL 'not fit and proper' as commodity derivative brokers|website=www.businesstoday.in|date=23 February 2019 }}{{Cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/market/commodities/nsel-case-commodity-arms-of-motilal-oswal-iifl-not-fit-and-proper-says-sebi-1550903694516.html|title=NSEL case: Commodity arms of Motilal Oswal, IIFL not fit and proper, says Sebi|first=Jayshree P.|last=Upadhyay|date=23 February 2019|website=Livemint}}{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/sebi-declares-commodity-arms-of-motilal-iifl-as-not-fit-and-proper/articleshow/68123136.cms|title=Sebi rules Motilal Oswal, IIFL commodity arms 'not fit and proper'|first=Reena|last=Zachariah|newspaper=The Economic Times}} In May 2022, SEBI imposed a fine of INR 2.5 million on Motilal Oswal for misutilization of client funds Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited is an Indian financial services company offering a range of financial products and services headquarted in Prabhadevi, Mumbai. The company was founded by Motilal Oswal and Raamdeo Agrawal in 1987.
The company was listed on the stock exchange on September 11,2007, after its initial public offering (IPO).
